rationale: Reachable pre-read rule: the exact-pin quality hook sends model-controlled tool arguments through checkSecretReadWithApproval, whose ordinary read path falls back to checkSecretReadGate. The helper normalizes the path, applies basename semantics, skips .pub files first, and returns a blocking reason when SECRET_BASENAME_RE matches. This review adopts only the basename branch; it does not infer that the list is complete or assess false-positive rates.
